text: Ko Alla woni On doginoowo on, onon ɓee yimɓe, ka njorndi, e hoore koyɗe mon maa e hoore daabeeji mon. Ko kanko kadi woni doginoowo on ka maayo e nder laaɗe mon. Haa si on wonii ka laaɗe maayo, ɗe doginira ɓe henndu laaɓundu, waɗɗiiɓe ɓen weltora ndun henndu laaɓundu. E nder nden weltaare maɓɓe, hanndu nduluuru (duleendu bippooru ara e maɓɓe, molloode mollooɗe(bempejje) ara e maɓɓe iwrabanngeeji ɗi fow, ɓe fellita wonnde kamɓe ɓe halkoto woni, ontuma ɓe toroo Alla tun, ɓe kafidataa Mo e goɗɗum goo, ɓe wi'a :"Si tawii tun A daɗndii men e ɗee jaribaaji ɗoo, pellet, men laatodat e yettooɓe Ma ɓe e dow ko neeminɗaa kon e amen".
